3020-619718 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT is AVE LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address c/o Action Check Cashing Corp., 81-36 Baxter Avenue, Elmhurst, New York 11373 (*Transferor") and SREP 10TH AVENUE VENTURE LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address c/o Soundview Real Estate Partners, 201 Tresser Blvd., Stamford, CT 06901 ("Transferee"). RECITALS: Transferor is the owner in fee simple of that certain parcel of land lying andbeingin the City,State and Countyof NewYorkdesignated asLot36inBlock693 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, New York County (the “Tax Map") and known by the street address of 195 Tenth Avenue, New York, New York, which land is more Transferor's Land and Transferor's Improvements herein being referred to collectively as"Transferor's Premises". Transferee is the owner in fee simple of that certain parcel of land lying and being in the City, State and County of New York designated as Lot 37 in Block 693 on the Tax Map and known by the street address of 197 Tenth Avenue, New York, New York,which land is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (the "Transferee's Land"), together with the improvements thereon (said existing improvements being herein referred to as “Transferee's Existing Building"), together with anyfuturereplacements thereof or additions theretowhether madebyTransferee or Transferee's successors or assigns, and including without limitation, Transferee's New Building (as hereinafter defined); the Transferee's Land, Transferee's Existing Building and Transferee's New Building herein being referred to collectively as "Transferee's Premises". Transferee intends to demolish all or a portion of Transferee's Existing Building and construct a new building and improvements on Transferee's Land or renovate and/or expand Transferee's Existing Building (said new or expanded building and improvements, together with any related improvements, additions, renovations, alterations, restorations, repairs and reconstructions thereto whether made by Transferee or Transferee's successors or assigns, herein being referred to collectively as "Transferee's New Building") with a bulk (as hereinafter defined) in excess of the bulk   r       d  Resolution (as hereinafter defined). The certificationby Selldorf Architects dated January 21,2014(attached hereto as Schedule 1) certifies that the Transferor's Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are 2,840 zoning square feet. Pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor and Transferee have executed and delivered a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the "Declaration"), intended to be recorded simultaneously herewith, creating a single combined zoning lot (the “Combined Zoning Lot") consisting of Transferee's Land and Transferor's Land in order to make available to Transferee all of Transferor's Excess Development Rights. Transferee has caused all parties in interest (as hereinafter defined) to the Transferee's Premises and Transferor has caused all parties in interest to Transferor's Premises, in each case as shown on the Parties-in-Interest Certification of First American Title Insurance Company, a copy of which is annexed hereto as Exhibit C, either to join in the Declaration or to execute a Waiver of Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions. The Transferor's Land is contiguous with Transferee's Land for at least ten (10) linear feet, and the Transferor's Land and Transferee's Land are all within a single block. their rights and obligations in and to the Combined Zoning Lot and other matters, and wish to provide to the maximum extent possible for each to exercise its rights in the future without having to seek any consent, approval or other action from the other. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and the mutual s follows: 1. DEFINITIONS. Defined terms used in this Agreement shall, unless the context otherwise requires, have the following meaning: 1.1“Additional Development Rights" shall mean any additional Development Rights that may become available to the Transferee's Premises or the Transferor's Premises or the Combined Zoning Lot (either by expansion of the Combined Zoning Lot by adding Additional Parcels by special permit, variance,or by other              Governmental Agency). 1.2 "Additional Parcels" -- shall mean one of more parcels of land on Block 693 and contiguous with the Combined Zoning Lot for at least ten (10) linear feet and not now part of the Combined Zoning Lot. 1.3 "Alterations"- See Section 8.7. 1.4 "Approval" or "Approvals" - See Section 7.1. 1.5 “"Approving Agency" shall mean an agency of the City of New York or any other Governmental Agency that takes an action that creates Upzoning Rights. 2
